description: Having dedicated myself to structured education around software development, I am seeking professional opportunities in this space.

Years of public sector work has exposed me to burdensome, clumsy software slowing processes and requiring workarounds. With this source of ‘inspiration by frustration’, combined with my logical, rational approach to problem solving, I have developed an ability to analyse and deconstruct real-world challenges, in order to design appropriate software structures to address them. I passionately believe that software should be intuitive, requiring minimal user input, enabling staff to concentrate on their core function and increasing organisational efficiency.

Having dealt with innumerable members of the public in almost every scenario imaginable across nearly two decades of policing, I have excellent communication, decision-making and problem-solving skills. You can read more about my policing experience here.
